about: On sets A and B of the synthetic flights, each parameter's 90% interval is held to three counts, each with a two-sided 99.9% Clopper–Pearson band: the two tails' bands must hold 5% and the inside's 90%. The least-squares fit's intervals take shares fitted on the calibration set; the Bayesian option's are its posterior's 5% and 95% points as they come, on the same flights.
